name: nail lain
source:
One morning, a mysterious pumpkin calling itself Lord Jack appeared before the protagonist (default name: Novela). 
As she conversed with Lord Jack who insisted he was her friend, the protagonist realized that her memories regarding her age, hobbies, and other personal details were missing. 
"Your memories have been hollowed out," Lord Jack explained, revealing that the men living in the same mansion possessed those memories. 
"Even though I cannot recall anything else, why is it that I can only remember them?" 
Determined to recover her memories, the protagonist resolved to deepen her bonds with them…

(Translated from official website synopsis)
translation:
一天早上，一个自称杰克勋爵的神秘南瓜出现在主角（默认名称：Novela）面前。
当她与坚持认为他是她朋友的杰克勋爵交谈时，主角意识到她关于年龄、爱好和其他个人细节的记忆缺失了。
“你的记忆被掏空了。”杰克大人解释道，并透露住在同一座宅邸的男人们都拥有这些记忆。
“虽然我什么也想不起来，但为什么我只记得它们呢？” 
主角决心恢复记忆，决定加深与他们的联系……

（摘自官网简介）
